source.source_text: Purpose: dry-run Broker policy for a proposed tool/target/arguments; MUST NOT execute it. Input: proposed_tool:string, target?:object, arguments?:object. Output: allow/deny, normalized target summary, required/missing scopes, reason codes; sensitive values redacted. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.policy.explain; timeout 3000ms; cap 128KiB; network none; filesystem metadata-only; deny secret content; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 1 planned.
